capabilities: Syncs vault files across Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android
Encrypts file contents and names with AES-256-GCM before upload
Saves losing edits as conflict copies instead of merging
Keeps version history and reversible deletes for 30-90 days
Shares vaults via Telegram bot on paid plans
extras: Plugin is MIT open source including encryption code, but the server implementation is closed-source; self-hosting guide planned. No telemetry. Lost passphrase makes synced data unrecoverable. Mobile syncs only while the app is open. Free tier 25 MB / 1 vault; sync stops accepting new data over quota.
motivation: Built for people priced out of other options: twice the storage per dollar, payable by bank card, crypto or rubles.
problem: Official Obsidian Sync is priced out of reach for some users, and DIY sync via Git, VPS or cloud storage requires setup they do not want.

relations.evidence: Same model as official Obsidian Sync.
Log in with Telegram: press Continue with Telegram, open the bot, and enter the code it sends you.
transfers encrypted file data directly to Cloudflare R2 object storage via short-lived signed URLs

requires.name: Obsyncian paid plan (more storage, vaults, sharing)
Telegram (login bot; email codes also work)

summary: End-to-end encrypted sync and backup for Obsidian vaults, with Telegram login, conflict copies, version history and paid vault sharing.
